title: Thinking Fast, Anywhere: One System-1 for the Decision Points of Any Agent Workflow
abstract: arXiv:2611.23751v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous LLM agents incur substantial cost and latency by invoking a large model (System-2) at every step, even when many intermediate actions choose among a small set of known candidates. Existing dual-system agents offload such decisions to a lightweight System-1 model, but rely on workflow-specific hooks authored per environment. We present AnyS1, a framework that turns human-authored procedural skills, whose instructions naturally specify where choices arise and which options apply, into a shared, domain-general source of decision points. Offline, AnyS1 mines grounded enumerable decisions across over 1,000 public skills, gathers execution-grounded trajectory states inside isolated containers to construct Any-DP, and trains a single calibrated 4B pointer System-1 with label smoothing. translated_title: 随时随地快速思考：面向任意智能体工作流决策点的统一System-1模型
translated_abstract: 自主运行的LLM智能体在每一步都调用大模型（System-2），即便许多中间动作只需在一小组已知候选项中进行选择，也会带来高昂的成本和延迟。现有的双系统智能体将此类决策卸载给轻量级的System-1模型，但依赖于针对每个环境手工编写的工作流特定钩子。我们提出AnyS1，这是一个框架，它将人类编写的程序性技能——其指令天然指明了选择出现的位置及可用选项——转化为共享的、领域通用的决策点来源。在离线阶段，AnyS1从超过1,000个公开技能中挖掘有依据的可枚举决策，在隔离容器中收集基于执行轨迹的状态以构建Any-DP数据集，并通过标签平滑训练出一个经过校准的单一4B指针式System-1模型。在运行时，编译后的工作流仅需一次前向传播即可完成常规决策，当置信度低于校准阈值时则回退至System-2。
tldr: AnyS1将人类编写的程序性技能转化为领域通用的决策点来源，训练出一个统一的4B轻量System-1模型，使任意智能体工作流在运行时通过一次前向传播即可完成常规决策，并在置信度不足时回退到大模型System-2。
en_tdlr: AnyS1 transforms human-authored procedural skills into a domain-general source of decision points, training a single calibrated 4B System-1 model that resolves routine decisions in any agent workflow with one forward pass while falling back to the large System-2 model when confidence is low.
